summary: This class examines the different customs regarding whether to recite the blessing before or after lighting Shabbat candles. It explores the halachic perspectives of various authorities and the specific practices within Middle Eastern and Halabi communities.
questions: Should the blessing for Shabbat candles be recited before or after lighting?
Does lighting Shabbat candles automatically mean one has accepted Shabbat?
Why do some people cover their eyes while reciting the blessing after lighting?
What was the custom regarding candle lighting in Halab?
Is it considered a blessing in vain to recite the blessing after the act of lighting is finished?
